name: R. J. Reynolds Tobacco Co.
message: I am enclosing a (?) letter & have written to one of my Rep. Mike Synar. I thought you may be interested to know you have one man behind you. I did not give my Rep. much proof. I would like to give you that now. My father lived to be 94 years of age. He chewed tobacco all of his adult life, maybe even longer. I believe at least 80 years. He died of an heart attack. No proof that tobacco was the cause. My oldest brother died at the age of 85. He smoked
title: Tle 94
